teaser: Person Graph: people and agents with their own keys, links that count only both ways, groups, claims, and a simulation of fakes being caught.
core_idea: Signed, typed, two-way links in people's own repositories, grouped into centres of gravity and walked by each person's AI, form a distributed social network in which trust spread over two-way links isolates fake clusters, as a simulation of 150 people and 40 fakes shows, until many real people are fooled.

quotes.text: Nothing is deleted and nobody is banned: the one-way links simply count for nothing, and anyone can see why.
Detection is spread across everyone's agent, not done by one platform.
